title: Isolation precautions

findings.where: Images 1, 3–6, 8, 10–13; ContactScene, DropletScene and AirborneScene linework
findings.title: Teal scene outlines miss the project's contrast target
findings.problem: C.teal linework against the tinted scene backgrounds falls to approximately 3.7–4.4:1, below the project's stated 4.5:1 minimum. This concerns the hand/person illustrations, not the teaching text. It is not a failure of WCAG's usual 3:1 non-text threshold.
findings.fix: Use C.accent for meaningful outlines over the scene gradients, or adjust the backgrounds and verify at least 4.5:1 in both themes.

assessment: No substantive clinical errors or incorrect step mappings found in the isolation diagram. One minor project-rule violation remains.
